scope: Actual independent exact-binding review for 13 Research tasks, 12 Interop Documentation tasks and D32, reusing the existing substantive technical reviews. No new GitHub approval identity or product acceptance is claimed.
verification_method: Independently reconstructed required path sets from each node outputs/prompt/research_refs/documentation_refs/contract_inputs.
Compared every required current byte sequence with its declared SHA-256, length and exact Git object at the fixed two repository commits.
Reconstructed canonical node digests and complete dependency/selection/contract subjects independently of the generator and matched snapshot/evidence/review subjects.
Checked node semantics and packet against the committed Plan source; checked actual report reviewer, disposition, blockers, subject scope, own output/packet pins and stored semantic projections.
Verified dependency and contract manifest hashes; dependencies are the prepared batch identities and retain their separate substantive review responsibilities.
Rechecked graph/index/manifest/input bytes for changes before writing this sole new attestation.
limitations: This records exact binding of these 26 subjects, not a new technical review of the other domains or a rerun of prior successful experiments.
The original reports and their stated finite evidence limits remain authoritative. The already-recorded supporting-fragment follow-up is not rewritten.
The prepared R/D dependency batch is not falsely called already accepted; the integrator must collect all scoped attestations and apply acceptance through existing final dependency/CI gates.
Local hash/subject validation does not authenticate a separate GitHub account, and this subagent does not claim one.
Final Plan acceptance, CI and merge receipts are separate integrator operations; no product implementation or production validation is authorized.
